scope: Dedicated loopback owned fictional records/account only. Native create/update/archive before/after loss, read-only original inspection and fresh-proof retry, ten simultaneous creates and stale/old replay. No provider/production/real chapter changes. Fixture records archived, account disabled/sessions revoked; private tombstones/audit remain, no physical-erasure claim. No raw contacts/proof/body/keys/credentials retained in report.
